```{r load libraries, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE}

```

```{r check DMN-LCN}
df<-read_csv('assets/table/pre_correlation_vector.csv', col_types = cols())
print("PRE Sus, DMN-DMN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("PRE Res, DMN-DMN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Res_DMN_LCN, mu=0)

print("PRE Sus, DMN-LCN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("PRE Res, DMN-LCN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Res_DMN_LCN, mu=0)

df<-read_csv('assets/table/peri_correlation_vector.csv', col_types = cols())
print("PERI Sus, DMN-DMN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("PERI Res, DMN-DMN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Res_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("PERI Sus, DMN-LCN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("PERI Res, DMN-LCN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Res_DMN_LCN, mu=0)

df<-read_csv('assets/table/post_correlation_vector.csv', col_types = cols())
print("POST Sus, DMN-DMN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("POST Res, DMN-DMN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Res_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("POST Sus, DMN-LCN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, mu=0)
print("POST Res, DMN-LCN > 0")
hedges_g(df$Res_DMN_LCN, mu=0)

```


```{r pre analysis}
df<-read_csv('assets/table/pre_correlation_vector.csv', col_types = cols())
print("PRE Sus vs. Res, DMN-DMN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_DMN, df$Res_DMN_DMN)
print("PRE Sus vs. Res, DMN-SN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_SN, df$Res_DMN_SN)
print("PRE Sus vs. Res, DMN-LCN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, df$Res_DMN_LCN)
print("PRE Sus vs. Res, SN-SN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_SN_SN, df$Res_SN_SN)
print("PRE Sus vs. Res, SN-LCN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_SN_LCN, df$Res_SN_LCN)
print("PRE Sus vs. Res, LCN-LCN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_LCN_LCN, df$Res_LCN_LCN)

```

```{r peri analysis}

df<-read_csv('assets/table/peri_correlation_vector.csv', col_types = cols())
print("PERI Sus vs. Res, DMN-DMN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_DMN, df$Res_DMN_DMN)
print("PERI Sus vs. Res, DMN-SN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_SN, df$Res_DMN_SN)
print("PERI Sus vs. Res, DMN-LCN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_DMN_LCN, df$Res_DMN_LCN)
print("PERI Sus vs. Res, SN-SN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_SN_SN, df$Res_SN_SN)
print("PERI Sus vs. Res, SN-LCN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_SN_LCN, df$Res_SN_LCN)
print("PERI Sus vs. Res, LCN-LCN")
hedges_g(df$Sus_LCN_LCN, df$Res_LCN_LCN)
```
